content.overview: Article 372 — Omitted / Repealed. Not current working law.
content.study:
Article 372 (“Continuance in force of existing laws and their adaptation”) of the Constitution of India has been omitted by constitutional amendment.

Status: Repealed / Omitted.
It is not current working law in the territory of India.

Examination Instruction:
When answering university or judicial service questions, note that Article 372 is omitted and identify the living constitutional or statutory provision that currently governs the subject matter.
